RagShortTexts: The Morosini patricians provided Venetia with doges and the first Latin Patriarch of.

Variants.Content: Ranked among the apostolic founding houses of Venice, the Morosini provided illustrious doges, admirals, and the first Latin Patriarch of Constantinople. Their deep-keeled galley fleets dominated trade lanes from Candia to Acre.
In the Great Council of Venice, a Morosini speech could pivot naval subsidies and declare embargoes against Byzantine ports.
